title: New mention pop-up follows the inbox's location rule
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (the standard Admin role). This is User A.
  2. A teammate at the same location to tag, User B, who can sign in: on a QA branch the second user is the Tech quick-login user (sign in from a private browser window with the Tech button; appears as "Tech ShopView"). They are listed under Settings -> Staff.
  3. Two locations User A and User B can both switch between with your initials at the top right -> Change Location, Location 1 and Location 2.
  4. A work order at Location 2 (switch to Location 2 with your initials at the top right -> Change Location, then top menu Work Orders -> Create Work Order).
  5. The customer's own notes: top menu Customers -> open the customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") -> Notes tab.
  6. To write a note on any of these records: on its Notes tab click New Note, type the message, type @ and pick the person from the list, then click Save.
  7. Keep User B signed in on a second browser, at Location 1.
custom_steps:
1. As User A, write a note on the Location 2 work order that @-mentions User B; watch User B's screen.
  2. As User A, write a note on the customer that @-mentions User B; watch User B's screen.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • No "New mention" pop-up appears for User B for the Location 2 work order note while they are at Location 1.
  • The "New mention" pop-up appears for User B for the customer note, at whichever location they are.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10244 (S1, Work the Notifications inbox); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297) as edited 2 October 2026, S1; read 5 Oct 2026. Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N9: “The live "New mention" pop-up follows the inbox. It does not appear for a note at another location (S1-N7). A note on a customer or an asset shows it at every location (S1-N8).”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
